review: All first- and second-year Dance of the Moonlight Jellies records were read directly against English. Spouse and villager voice, the candle boat and migration, sea lore, pollution, Lunaloo references, canonical festival and species terminology, player-neutral wording, trailing spaces, emotes and dialogue fields were checked. Both closing narrations were translated while the full procession, timing, animation and multiplayer event skeletons remain exact; setup scripts and conditions are preserved.
